title: 🍄 Build and look at the demo store
about: The first --demo command builds the store (a few minutes, with a progress bar): the database, the synthetic files, the real ingest and the exchange links. Later commands reuse it.

title: 📊 Backtest the model
about: Every past race priced as of before the weekend, before qualifying and before the race, with track features on and off, scored against the results and against uniform and grid baselines.

title: 🔮 Forecast the rest of the season
about: The next races (Rainbow Road is a sprint weekend) and both championships; --save stores the run the book and the web app read.

title: 🏁 Run a live private book
about: Bowser's Castle (round 9) replayed on a simulated clock: the maker's book opens before practice, reprices after each session from the model's stage runs, 100 simulated takers trade against it, the book closes at lights out and settles from the results.

title: 💰 Price a sportsbook's lines
about: The pack's sportsbook book (a generic sportsbook's lines on rounds 10 and 11) against the model's forecast and the exchanges' quotes: EV against each, side by side.
